en-UK.name: Tavern Plugin Importer
en-UK.description: Imports third-party tavern-style plugins from git repository URLs.
en-UK.description_markdown: Paste a git repository URL (e.g. a GitHub link to a tavern-style plugin) to download it into the Tavern Plugin Interface. The repository must contain a valid `manifest.json`; invalid downloads are rolled back automatically.
en-UK.author: beilu

zh-CN.name: 酒馆插件导入器
zh-CN.description: 从 git 仓库网址导入酒馆系第三方插件。
zh-CN.description_markdown: 粘贴 git 仓库网址（如酒馆系插件的 GitHub 链接）即可下载进酒馆插件接口。仓库必须含合法的 `manifest.json`，不合法的下载会自动回滚删除。
zh-CN.author: beilu
